 c.move(base=[.15,.29,0]);p=np.array([.50179748,.00055671,.18]);c.goto(p,R);p[2]=.034;c.goto(p,R);c.move(grip=1,n=20)

 c.move(q=q,base=[bx,by,0],grip=1,n=100)
 q=np.array([0,-.7,np.pi,-.3,0,-.6,np.pi/2]);c.move(q=q,grip=1,n=120)
 c.save();log=[]
 for i in range(9):
  a=np.zeros(18);a[3:10]=np.clip(q-c.o['proprio']['arm_pos'],-.1,.1);a[4]=.1 if i<5 else -.1;a[12]=speed if i<5 else 0;a[10]=1 if i<release else 0
  c.o=c.r.step('delta',a.tolist(),images=True)
  print('throw',i,'q2',c.o['proprio']['arm_pos'][1],'v2',c.o['proprio']['arm_vel'][1],'grip',c.o['proprio']['gripper_pos']);Image.fromarray(c.o['images']['robot_wrist']).save('/app/output/throw%d.png'%i)
  log.append({k:v for k,v in c.o.items() if k not in ['images','depth']})
  if c.o['done']:print('DONE',c.o['reason']);return
 json.dump(log,open('/app/output/throwlog.json','w'))

from pathlib import Path
import json,numpy as np
p=Path('/app/output/gen.py'); run=p.read_text().replace('from control import *\n','').replace('def run(speed=8,release=1,','def run(speed=9,release=2,').replace("default=8)","default=9)").replace("default=1)","default=2)")
run=run.replace("c=Control();c.o=c.r.reset(images=False);c.grip=0", "c=Control()\n if c.o.get('reason') == 'success':\n  print('DONE success'); return\n if c.o['step'] != 0 or c.o['done']:\n  c.o=c.r.reset(images=False)\n c.grip=0")
